title: Market Mosaic: model-fit trigger playbook and lightweight scout experiments
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a repeatable playbook (Market Mosaic) that codifies buyer-facing triggers, lightweight scout experiments, and commercial propensity signals to prioritize which open models and variants we source, test, and onboard. This ticket scopes the playbook, defines minimal experiment templates (A/B + cost/latency probes), and produces a prioritized list of model leads for the sourcing backlog. Focus on high-signal buyer cohorts (SaaS PLG, mid-market enterprise search, regulated FinServ) and explicit triggers (pricing movement, latency arbitrage events, supply outages, vendor announcements).
tasks: Define 6 buyer-cohort trigger heuristics and associated telemetry signals
Design 3 lightweight scout experiment templates (embeddings, chat, reranking) with pass/fail thresholds
Create a compact scoring rubric combining latency delta, cost delta, quality delta, and onboarding effort
Run two live scouts in APAC and US-EAST using representative workloads (2026-03-01 -> 2026-03-10)
Synthesize scout results into prioritized model-leads doc and handoff to model sourcing
Draft playbook doc and one-pager for GTM and partner teams
comments: 2026-01-22 — Kickoff: aligned with Growth and DevRel. Decided to scope MVP to 3 cohorts to keep experiments lean.
2026-02-02 — Design review: Product + Research approved experiment templates. Feedback: add automated cost-sample collection at token/granularity.

2026-02-15 — Engineering sync: ENG infra constraints for APAC runners; assigned ENG-2912 to provisioning. Trade-off: use 2 smaller GPU types for scouts vs one large instance to reduce cost and get variance across hardware.

2026-03-11 — Scout run complete: initial signals show model X-phi has 18% lower embedding latency in APAC but 6% quality regression on our evaluator set. Added recommendation to run a targeted reranking probe.
2026-03-12 — Legal review note: flagged potential licensing edge-case for model Y-zeta; set dependency to clarify commercial terms before onboarding (see dependencies).
2026-03-14 — PM synthesis: prioritized 7 model leads for sourcing; prepared playbook draft for review by product leadership next week.
notes: Acceptance criteria: playbook doc + 3 experiment templates + prioritized model-leads (top 10) + handoff ticket to sourcing
Measurement: report per-scout delta for latency (p50/p95), cost per 1M tokens, and precision@K on representative eval sets
Risks: scout results can be sensitive to prompt templates; mitigation: run each scout with 3 prompt variants and report variance
Follow-ups: schedule canary onboarding for any shortlisted model with integrated runtime perf profile and quantization recommendation
